mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 5.0% and remains above 5.0% for 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE has been above 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer and housing demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline by > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline by > 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0, the supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output signal an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and decline in employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% from the prior month signals a severe labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the monetary policy is restrictive, which increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.
